title: Allow pinning app in application menu to task manager on only a single activity as with  the task manager context menu
line: With more than one activity, "Pin to Task Manager" in the application launchers is now a submenu to pin an app on all activities, the current one, or chosen ones.
explanation: Kickoff and Kicker get their "Pin to Task Manager" action from libkicker, which could only call the task manager's addLauncher(), so the app was always pinned on every activity, and the action vanished once the app was pinned on any activity. The task manager now exposes launcherActivities(), addLauncherToActivity() and removeLauncherFromActivity(). With two or more activities, libkicker turns the action into a checkable submenu (On All Activities, On the Current Activity, then each activity) with the same semantics as the task manager's own pin menu; with one activity, or with a task manager that lacks the new calls, the old flat action stays.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: let other widgets pin launchers to activities

The Application Launcher can only pin an app to the task manager on all
activities, as the task manager only exposes a call to add a launcher
everywhere. Expose its launcher activities and calls to add or remove one.

BUG: 525899

applets/kicker: allow pinning apps to the task manager per activity

With more than one activity, "Pin to Task Manager" always pinned the app
on every activity and disappeared once it was pinned anywhere. It is now
a submenu like the task manager's own, to pin or unpin it per activity.

BUG: 525899

media.caption: Kickoff, two activities (Default, Work): right-clicking Konsole offers a plain "Pin to Task Manager" that pins it on every activity
With the change: "Pin to Task Manager" opens a submenu like the task manager's: On All Activities, On the Current Activity, Default, Work
